description:
A media consultancy needs a robust screener question for their 'Streaming Media Consumption 2025' survey to ensure data quality. Log in to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!) and create a new survey with this title. Add a question group named 'Screener'. Inside, create a Multiple Choice question asking 'Which of the following video streaming services do you currently subscribe to?'. 

Use the following answer options and codes exactly:
- S01: Netflix
- S02: Hulu
- S03: Disney+
- S04: Amazon Prime Video
- S05: HBO Max
- NONE: None of the above

Configure the following data quality settings for this question:
1. Enable the 'Other' option so respondents can type in unlisted services.
2. Make the question mandatory.
3. Enable 'Random order' (randomization) for the answer options to reduce order bias.
4. Configure 'Exclusive option' logic so that selecting 'None of the above' (NONE) automatically unchecks all other options.

Activate the survey when finished.
